trigger: Direct user friction: landing-page catch-up felt todo-like; accidental bulk caught-up action needed undo; user wanted to resolve items one-by-one and act from the landing page, including explicit human/GitHub blockers.
invariant: ONE HELD OBJECT → 1–3 LAWFUL MOVES → WITNESS → RETURN
delta: Promote the existing held capability aperture from opt-in ?cap=1 to default root behavior.
FIELD / CATCH + ACT shows three unequal signal classes together: changed addressed routes, explicit CURRENT human/world gates, and public GitHub issues.
Changed routes resolve locally one-by-one with SEEN; the most recent local acknowledgement is REWINDable. MARK ALL remains a reversible convenience.
WAITING active gates replace ACK LOCAL pseudo-work with HOLD + DO →; HOLD binds the same FIELD focus and DO opens the native route.

Held-object root actions are executable and honest: OPEN/DO enters the native owner, COPY ACTION emits an authority-NONE handoff packet, TRACE opens evidence. Domain-specific move labels remain hints, not fake root execution.

authority.root_actions: FIELD view may navigate/copy/trace; native effects remain host-owned

reversibility.irreversible_world_effects: not simulated; require native authority and evidence

stop: No new universal shell or event bus.
Do not add more action verbs until a native host can lawfully expose them.
